reviews.comment: Best professor ever.Explains everything so precisely,makes difficult concepts easy to understand.Exams are easy,way easier than homework,which can take some time but prepares for exams. During recitation, we get group work(much more difficult than the quiz) before the quiz, then take the quiz which is very similar to the group work but much easier

Amazing professor and does his best to make sure that everyone really understand what is being taught. Exams and quizzes aren't bad. The homework is much more difficult than exams and can take a while to do but I don't mind because I feel like it really prepares us for the exam. Super nice and chill guy, definitely take his class.

He was a very good lecturer however the homework and exams were tough. Very happy to help during office hours, this was probably the hardest class I've taken yet. Dr. Willis made sure we knew what was going on
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Lots of homework--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: The material itself can get tough, but Dr. Willis genuinely wants you to understand the content. He doesn't post notes on Canvas so go to class. Complete the homework, practice exams, and ask questions to do well. He is more than happy to help and explain content during his office hours and after class.

Best professor I have taken at Texas A&M. His lecturing was very good but what made the class awesome was the mega-PDF of (almost) all the notes. I'm an engineering student so my math background was a bit weaker, and I still felt like the material was explained in such a way that everything made sense.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Gives good feedback--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: He acts like his class is the only one we're taking, he assigned hw during weeks we had exams and then during the last lecture (a few days before the final) he didn't finish the whole lecture and told us to review it on our own time and is testing it on the final. He is a good lecturer though

He is the absolute best lecturer I've had at this university. Almost every student showed up for class consistently. He explains the topic and intuition before diving into the proper theory. It's still not an easy course, you really do work for the grade. I felt like I came out of this course with a great understanding of the course and it's goals.

Dr. Willis is the best math professor I've ever had. He is incredible at explaining complex concepts in plain terms and developing a great algebraic and geometric intuition for the concepts. He probably has the most reasonable grading system and does not pull tricks on exams (they are still tough, though). He also is funny a lot of the time.

Lectures were always clear and concise. Exams never felt terrible and he gives you practice exams that are pretty similar. He posts notes online and attendance isn't mandatory so when I got covid and missed classes for a week I didn't get behind. All around a great guy and what I look for in a math Prof. Would definitely recommend him to anyone.

Prof Willis is a legend, his lectures are very concise and in-detail, definitely the best prof I have had at tamu. You genuinely learn with the lectures. All homework is relevant review for exams and exams are very reasonable. He's also pretty funny.
